amendments.backdating_prohibited: The TOP100 stratum carries its own freeze date. It must never be presented as frozen on 2026-08-14 with the original three strata, and no TOP100 result before 2026-08-21 is admissible as prospective evidence.
amendments.selection_rationale_recorded_before_any_: Availability and stability were measured on the archived point-in-time Gateway scanner before any TOP100 return existed: 421 eligible shortable names, all 100 top-ranked names present in all 15 archived snapshots, and composition turnover of 7.5 percent per day for TOP100 against 22.5 percent per day for a 20-name set. No return series informed this choice.

amendments.bar_admission: Only completed UTC daily bars are admitted. OKX confirm=0 bars and any bar dated on the run date are rejected, and a bar whose open is not exactly UTC midnight fails closed.
amendments.first_pinning_run_requirement: The first production run must execute where all four venues are reachable. A run from a restricted network silently pins every asset to whichever venues answered, and pins are sticky by design, so a degraded first run would persist a degraded assignment.
amendments.problem: The V12 universe is multi-venue but the frozen V11 price pipeline reads OKX swaps only. Measured on the 2026-08-21 TOP100: 94 of 100 names have an OKX perpetual, and 6 (PAXG, XMR, FET, MNT, ACE, CAKE) do not, despite passing the shortable and liquid filter on another venue. An OKX-only engine would drop those 6 silently, making venue listing decisions act as an unregistered selection rule.
amendments.resolution: Price each base asset through the frozen venue preference order BINANCE_FUTURES, BYBIT_LINEAR, OKX_SWAP, HYPERLIQUID. Measured coverage with this order is 100 of 100 priced and 100 of 100 meeting the 30-day minimum history.
amendments.venue_pinning_rule: A venue is PINNED to an asset at first admission and recorded with its pin date. Later runs must reuse the pinned venue even when a higher-preference venue becomes reachable. A change is permitted only when the pinned venue stops serving the instrument, and it is written as an explicit venue_changes event naming from, to and date. Without pinning, reachability alone could reprice an asset from a different venue day to day and inject level shifts that would read as returns.

coverage_measured_before_any_return.note: The two required venues cover the stratum on their own. Binance and Bybit were never load-bearing for TOP100 coverage. No return series informed this reorder; it was fixed before any V12 price panel was committed.

amendments.problem: Amendment MULTI_VENUE_DAILY_PRICE_PIPELINE_WITH_VENUE_PINNING required the first pinning run to execute where all four venues are reachable. That premise is false. Binance Futures answers HTTP 451 and Bybit linear answers HTTP 403 from GitHub runners and from the research container, so the guard refused every run and no pins could ever be established. The premise was asserted without being measured.
amendments.resolution: The frozen venue preference order becomes OKX_SWAP, HYPERLIQUID, BINANCE_FUTURES, BYBIT_LINEAR, and the required venue set for a first pinning run becomes OKX_SWAP and HYPERLIQUID. Putting the reachable venues first makes venue assignment independent of where the pinning run executes, which is the property a permanent pin needs. Binance and Bybit remain in the order as a genuine fallback for an instrument neither primary venue carries.
amendments.supersedes: first_pinning_run_requirement of MULTI_VENUE_DAILY_PRICE_PIPELINE_WITH_VENUE_PINNING: 'all four venues reachable' is replaced by 'both required venues reachable'.

cost_model_by_liquidity_band.capacity_convention: position capped at 1 percent of the name 24h volume at 10 percent book weight
cost_model_by_liquidity_band.capacity_warning: TOP100 divides usable capacity by roughly seven against TOP30. A TOP100 result is only meaningful for a book at or below the capacity ceiling of its worst band.
cost_model_by_liquidity_band.reason: The frozen V11 premise of 3 bps slippage per side was set for a 20-name high-liquidity universe. Median 24h liquidity in the 76-100 band is about 8 percent of the 1-30 band, so carrying 3 bps unchanged into the tail would understate cost. Slippage is therefore scaled per band instead of held constant.
cost_model_by_liquidity_band.recalibration_policy: These bands are frozen for the prospective window. They may be replaced only by measured fills from an independent execution study, never by tuning against observed strategy return.

external_evidence_policy: External Delta holdings are audit-only and must never determine eligibility, liquidity rank, inclusion or exclusion.
historical_replay_policy: Any replay using a universe selected from this 2026-08-14 snapshot before the freeze date is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY because of survivorship and current-liquidity conditioning.
purpose: Prospective reconstruction of a broad liquid and shortable multi-venue universe from the exact immutable successful Daily Research artifact, without copying external Delta holdings.
ranking: descending maximum observed 24h liquidity across eligible Gateway venues; documented spot or CoinGecko volume proxy only where derivative venue volume is unavailable
selection_policy: Freeze all four strata prospectively. Do not select a stratum from external Delta return, visible portfolio overlap, or observed strategy performance of any stratum.
symbol_policy: Preserve base asset exactly and prefer an available raw derivative symbol in the order OKX swap, Hyperliquid perp, Binance Futures, Bybit linear. Aliases are never used to force external overlap.
